metadata.case_name: KO CHU KEUNG v TEMMUK ENGINEERING CO., LIMITED AND WAH SUNG CONSTRUCTION & PILING LTD.

plaintiff.occupation_before: construction worker doing welding works at the foundation and superstructure of 53 Perkins Road, Jardine’s Lookout, Hong Kong
plaintiff.occupation_after: part-time petrol attendant at a gas station

injuries.description: 20 cm laceration over his right scalp
source: 20 cm laceration over his right scalp
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of head

injuries.description: Gustilo 3A open fracture right tibia and fibula; 10 cm × 4 cm contaminated wound over the right leg with exposed bone
source: a 10 cm × 4 cm contaminated wound over the right leg with exposed bone.
The diagnosis was Gustilo 3A open fracture right tibia and fibula.

injuries.description: Injury to his right arm caused by the oxy-acetylene welding set being continually turned on
source: the oxy-acetylene welding set was continually turned on,and injured his right arm.

manifestations.description: itchiness especially in summer at the right anterior scar, and also scar on scrubbing and on pressure
scar on his right calf and another one on his right arm... those scars are prominent... these scars at times would be itchy and painful
on and off pain in the right mid shin (leg area)
on exercise eg playing basketball, jumping/hopping, squatting and running increases pain; running for 15 minutes needs to slow down and/or walking
on gentle bumping at the fracture site and the scar increases in pain
some degrees of weakness are found in the right lower limb but he requires no walking aids
pain of bumping at the right anterior knee scar as well as squatting and kneeing

treatments_received: operation under general anesthesia with intramedullary nailing of the right tibia and plating of the right fibula (performed on the day of admission)
removal of implanted device from tibia and fibula (plate, screws, nail and locking bolts) (13 July 2015)
transfer to MacLehose Medical Rehabilitation Centre for further training
54 sessions of physiotherapy treatment from 12 March to 29 December 2014
13 private sessions of physiotherapy at Ho Man Tin from 4 December 2015 to 5 June 2016
work hardening programme (27 sessions) until 5 February 2015

losses.description: scar on his right calf which is prominent and at times would be itchy and painful
scar on his right arm which is prominent and at times would be itchy and painful
reduced ability for frequent standing, walking, squatting, staircase or slope climbing and activities that involved heavy manual work; overall endurance reduced

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: expected reduction in performance and enjoyment of pre-accident sports and exercises
reduction of working efficiency as a welder with requirement of intermittent breaks (15 minutes after each 1.5 hours) resulting in a loss of about 1/7 of his income when working as a welder
